videos.title: DB SCHENKER
videos.subtitle: Webex CC | Cloud-native, secure, scalable contact center for businesses
videos.description:
Cisco Webex Contact Center is a next-generation cloud contact center solution inspired by customers and architected for business. Designed and built from its foundation as a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) cloud solution, Webex Contact Center's best-of-breed platform architecture brings your business the innovation, flexibility, scalability, and agility of the cloud without sacrificing security.

As a cloud-based subscription, Webex Contact Center enables rapid time to market and time to new revenue while minimizing upfront capital investment.
